proposed_statement_changes.proposed: For fixed \(s\in[1,2]\), \(\tau_n=T_n\kappa_n^{1-1/s}\), and every admissible strength sequence has a subsequence in exactly one component of \(\mathfrak R\). If \(s=1\), then \(T_n=\tau_n\), so the finite-positive slope face and the divergent location-entropy faces remain distinct according to \(\lambda_n=\tau_n/\log(e/\kappa_n)\). If fixed \(s>1\) and \(\lambda_n\) remains bounded, then \(\tau_n\to0\); if fixed \(s>1\) and \(\tau_n\to\infty\), then \(\lambda_n\to\infty\). Moreover, there exists \(C>0\), depending only on \(s\), \(M\), and \(\alpha\), such that \[L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\ge C r_n\] for every \(n\ge1\) and every \(0<\kappa_n\le1/8\); hence this lower comparison holds on every component of \(\mathfrak R\). Cutoff recovery \(\mathsf{CR}(s,\kappa_\bullet)\) does not by itself imply shrinking effect intervals: for every fixed \(s\in(1,2]\), there is an admissible strength sequence with \(\lambda_n\to\infty\), \(\tau_n\to0\), \(r_n=1\) eventually, and \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\ge C>0\). Finally, \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{cert}}\subseteq\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{recovered}}\); this restriction applies only to the still-unproved conservative finite-grid attainment direction and not to the global lower bound.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen claim incorrectly confined the lower comparison to the recovered regime. The established all-strength lower-frontier theorem proves the existential bound uniformly for every admissible \(n\) and \(\kappa_n\), while the explicit recovered-but-flat sequence proves nonshrinkage despite cutoff recovery. The certification subregime remains relevant only to the unproved upper/attainment direction.

proposed.justification: The exact scale identities separate global cutoff localization from slope-induced indistinguishability, while the established all-strength converse turns that separation into a regime-uniform minimax expected-length lower bound.
proposed.gap: Unknown-break results classify location recovery, but they do not supply the weak fuzzy-RD identity linking \(T_n\) and \(\tau_n\), the recovered-but-flat nonshrinkage witness, or the resulting global honest-length converse.
proposed.consumer: An applied user may invoke the lower bound on every strength regime, while treating \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{cert}}\) only as the proposed domain for the still-unproved finite-grid attainment direction.
